sum: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online casino gaming and sports betting company in Spain, Mexico, and internationally. It offers online casino games available in land-based casinos, gaming halls, and gambling establishments, such as slot machines, table games, and bingo, as well as online casino through its website and mobile applications; and online sports betting and other bets under the Codere brand.
